name: portrait-9x16-universal
notes: One safe box for TikTok and Facebook Reels together (measured from iPhone screenshots): text x 80-900, y 360-1620. FB Reels hides ~350 px at the top (status bar, icons) and TikTok ~190 px at the bottom (name, caption); both hide ~180 px on the right. Captions end at y 1620. Use it for channels posting the same file to both; portrait-9x16 keeps the older, more generous top and bottom.
